title: PermDeath
description: The ultimate Hardcore experience. Death is permanent... unless your friends save you
body:
⚔️ Hardcore Mechanics
Ban on Death: Die? You're out. The server kicks and bans you instantly.
No Death Screen: Bypasses the "Respawn" screen for a seamless kick.
Scary Atmosphere: Plays a Wither Spawn sound globally at the death location.
Auto-Unban Timer: Configurable option to turn perma-bans into temporary bans (e.g., auto-revive after 24 hours).

❤️ Revival System
Revival Heads: Victims drop their own head upon death.
Indestructible: Revival heads are immune to fire, lava, cactus, and explosions.
The Ritual: Placing the head unbans the player and sets their respawn point.
Instant Rejoin: When the revived player logs in, they are instantly teleported to the head, and the block vanishes.

🔒 Built-in Authentication (Optional)
Secure Login: commands for /register and /login.
Limbo Mode: Unauthenticated players are frozen and blinded.
True Hiding: Unlogged players are hidden from Tab-List and cannot see other players until they log in.
Inventory Protection: Items are hidden and secured while in Limbo.
Smart Location: Players return to their exact quit location (or revival point) after logging in.
